best_idea: Track each finger's side in an owner map, drop a side's guard only when its last finger lifts, and gate all touch intake on one engine-state flag.
decision_why: Keep the per-finger owner map, the last-finger-drops-the-hold rule and the state gate; drop the screen-half flipper mapping because the Frankendom touch layout was not read and the fight uses its own controls.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone a second finger on the left half keeps the guard up after the first lifts, and lifting both drops it; a server test asserts touch intake changes no guard state while the fight is not live.
